title: aganope leucobotrya
intro: Aganope leucobotrya, commonly known as White Kino, is a plant species in the family Apocynaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing pain and fighting infections. The therapeutic actions of Aganope leucobotrya include its ability to exhibit analgesic and antipyretic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for managing fever and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
